hook: WhatsApp bookings work, right up until they don't.
caption:
WhatsApp bookings work, right up until they don't.

If you get a few bookings a week and you answer quickly, WhatsApp is fine. Keep it.

But here's when it starts to break:
- Two people book the same slot, because the first message got buried under the next twenty.
- Your evenings go on scrolling through chats to work out who's coming tomorrow.
- People forget their booking, and nothing reminded them. That's an empty slot you could have filled.

A simple booking system fixes all three. Customers pick an open slot themselves, you see your whole day at a glance, and reminders go out on their own. That's the kind of thing we build.

How many bookings do you handle a week? Comment below.
